reference: procps-ng top(1) batch output layout (procps-ng 4.0.4 on Debian), recorded as contracts: the process table and counters differ between any two runs, so in-script assertions check the layout.
coverage: procps batch layout (top/Tasks/%Cpu(s)/MiB Mem/MiB Swap/header/row), frames, -bn1 clustering, -d fractions, -p.
exclusions: Exact counters and process rows; interactive mode; -c, -i, -S, -H are accepted without effect.

cases.purpose: top -b -n 1 writes procps' summary lines, a blank line and the column header (guest compatibility pass 1).
cases.stdout:
top-line
tasks
cpu
mem
swap
blank
header
row

cases.purpose: -n counts frames in batch mode; procps' clustered -bn1 and fractional -d work; -p limits the rows.
cases.script:
[[ $(top -b -n 2 -d 0.1 | grep -c '^top - ') == 2 ]] && echo two-frames
[[ $(top -bn1 | grep -c '^%Cpu(s):') == 1 ]] && echo clustered
rows=$(top -b -n 1 -p $$ | sed -n '8,$p')
[[ $rows == *" $$ "* && $(wc -l <<<"$rows") == 1 ]] && echo pid-filter
top -b -n 1 -d 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo zero-delay-rc=$?
